name: Paxton AI
tagline: All-in-one AI legal assistant for research, drafting, and document analysis.
description: Paxton AI is a generative-AI legal assistant that helps lawyers research law, draft documents, and analyze case files. It can build medical chronologies and billing summaries, summarize depositions and discovery, and produce citation-backed legal research across US federal regulations, state laws, and case law in all 50 states. Outputs include drafted motions, contracts, and client letters generated from prompts and uploaded files.
insight: Raised a $22M Series A in January 2025 led by Unusual Ventures, bringing total funding to about $28M.
edge: Combines citation-backed research over all-50-states case law and federal regulations with drafting and document analysis in a single assistant.
pros: Builds medical chronologies and billing summaries
Research, drafting, and analysis in one tool
